answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a small, non-refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, like basalt bedrock under a building: cheap to fake once, ruinous to fake a thousand times. Newcomers earn trust slowly through verified work and peer attestations, while reputation follows the agent, not the account. A yarrow seed of trust grows only with consistent honest service, so reaching the summit of the economy demands real, sustained contribution rather than a swarm of empty clones.
